create_depth_config: create a DepthConfig dataclass to configure DINOv3 monocular depth estimation training and evaluation
create_optimizer_config: create an OptimizerConfig dataclass to set learning rate, beta1, beta2, weight decay, and gradient clip values
create_transform_config: create a TransformConfig dataclass to configure train and eval image transforms with normalization settings
make_depth_train_transforms_from_config: build depth training transforms from a DepthConfig including random crop, brightness, and rotation augmentations
make_depth_eval_transforms_from_config: build depth evaluation transforms from a DepthConfig for val or test splits with optional TTA
